children: Norwegian Air Shuttle's passenger numbers rose in August compared with the same month a year earlier.
The airline said Friday that it carried 2.5 million passengers in the month, up 3.5% on year and compared with 2.7 million passengers in July.
Norwegian's capacity in August rose 3.3% on year, while traffic rose 3.8%.
The group's total passengers--including its Wideroe regional airline--numbered 2.86 million.
Norwegian noted that an air traffic controller strike at the end of the month led to cancellations and delays for more than 20,000 of its passengers.
"We see that the booking momentum remains at a high level heading into the autumn, in particular for the autumn school holidays," Chief Executive Officer Geir Karlsen said.
